name: drawer-06
description: Filter drawer with category checkboxes, a price slider and an active filter count.

files.content:
"use client" import * as React from "react" import { ListFilterIcon } from "lucide-react" import { Badge } from "@workspace/ui/components/badge" import { Button } from "@workspace/ui/components/button" import { Checkbox } from "@workspace/ui/components/checkbox" import { Drawer, DrawerClose, DrawerContent, DrawerDescription, DrawerFooter, DrawerHeader, DrawerTitle, DrawerTrigger, } from "@workspace/ui/components/drawer" import { Field, FieldGroup, FieldLabel, FieldLegend, FieldSet, } from "@workspace/ui/components/field" import { Slider } from "@workspace/ui/components/slider" const categories = ["Jackets", "Knitwear", "Shirts", "Trousers", "Accessories"] export default function ProductFiltersDrawer() { const [selected, setSelected] = React.useState(["Knitwear"]) const [price, setPrice] = React.useState(150) const active = selected.length + (price < 300 ? 1 : 0) function toggle(category: string) { setSelected((current) => current.includes(category) ? current.filter((item) => item !== category) : [...current, category] ) } return ( }> Filters {active > 0 && {active}} Filters Showing 84 of 312 products
Category {categories.map((category) => ( toggle(category)} /> {category} ))}
Max price {"$" + price}
setPrice(typeof value === "number" ? value : (value[0] ?? 0)) } aria-label="Max price" />
